name: Re:Set Episode 2 Remake : Under the Golden Sun
source:
“After catching Lust, we know that Greed is after our asses. This time, our demon-hunting involves some kind of an old mansion with a creepy secret within its basement. Classic murder story ensues and we have to solve it before more people die! With the help of my schoolmates, a quirky biologist, and a creepy couple I know nothing about, I’m going to solve my first murder case! But wait, Gerald’s acting kind of weird lately. For a guy who has three different personalities, he is definitely not normal, but he's never THIS weird. I wonder if he needs laxatives…”

ReSet is an episodic game consists of seven episodes where you play as both Mike and Gerald in order to retrieve all the seven demons back, and probably recover Gerald's missing memories.
In this episode, they are involved in a double homicide. Can they solve it? Will they also manage to catch a demon, or be caught instead? It's all up to you! Good luck! Also watch your back most of the time, someone might put a “Kick Me” sign on your shirt without you noticing.

[From [url=http://mementomori.vnovel.com/released-games/reset-ep-2-under-the-golden-sun]Memento Mori Productions[/url]]
translation:
“抓到《欲望》后，我们知道贪婪就在追我们的屁股。这一次，我们的恶魔狩猎涉及到一座古老的宅邸，地下室里有一个令人毛骨悚然的秘密。经典的谋杀故事接踵而至，我们必须在更多的人死去之前解决它！在我的同学、一位古怪的生物学家和一对我一无所知的令人毛骨悚然的夫妇的帮助下，我要解决我的第一起谋杀案！但是等一下，杰拉德最近的表现有点奇怪。对于一个拥有三个孩子的人来说性格不同，他肯定不正常，但他从来没有这么奇怪过，我不知道他是否需要泻药……”

《ReSet》是一款由七集组成的情景游戏，你将扮演迈克和杰拉德，以找回所有七个恶魔，并可能恢复杰拉德丢失的记忆。
在这一集中，他们卷入了一起双重凶杀案。他们能解决吗？他们会成功抓住恶魔，还是被抓住呢？这一切都取决于你！祝你好运！大部分时间也要小心你的背后，有人可能会在你没有注意到的情况下在你的衬衫上贴上“踢我”的标志。

[来自[url=http://mementomori.vnovel.com/released-games/reset-ep-2-under-the-golden-sun]死亡纪念制作公司[/url]]
